W.note: Careful opacity/transform-only glow with staggered curves and good focus/reduced-motion, but the demo button is a small secondary one and the effect is a modest blue smudge.

X.note: Lovely full-width gradient button with slow lilac wash and drifting arrow, but 'transition: all', 1s+ timings and a whitened label at peak hurt legibility and snappiness.

Y.note: Glass pill on a dark glow field with a fast clear hover-in, lingering soft glow on exit, strong focus and reduced-motion handling, cheap pre-blurred layers.

Z.note: Most ethereal: blooming blurred halo with overshoot bezier, appearing arrow and slow exhale release, though infinite float/spin loops and blur filter transitions cost more to render.
